source:
block-beta
  columns 2
  cli["CLI"] engine["Engine"]
  cli --> engine

C4Context
  Person(dev, "Developer")
  System(cli, "CLI", "Local runtime")
  Rel(dev, cli, "Runs commands")

classDiagram
  Project --> Service : owns

erDiagram
  PROJECT ||--o{ SERVICE : owns

eventmodeling
  tf 01 ui Console
  tf 02 cmd Start
  tf 03 evt Started

flowchart TD
  A[Read config] --> B[Start services]

gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Example
  Prepare :a, 2026-01-01, 1d
  Check :after a, 1d

gitGraph
  commit
  branch review
  checkout review
  commit

kanban
  todo[Todo]
    task[Read config]
  done[Done]
    checked[Check config]

mindmap
  root((Project))
    Services
    Settings

packet-beta
  0-7: "Header"
  8-15: "Payload"

pie title Synthetic counts
  "Group A" : 2
  "Group B" : 1

quadrantChart
  x-axis Low scope --> High scope
  y-axis Low effort --> High effort
  quadrant-1 Review
  quadrant-2 Explore
  quadrant-3 Begin
  quadrant-4 Plan
  Example: [0.3, 0.6]

sankey-beta
  Input,Output,2
  Input,Other,1

sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant CLI
  participant Engine
  CLI->>Engine: Start
  Engine-->>CLI: Result

stateDiagram-v2
  direction TB
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Running: start
  Running --> Idle: stop

timeline
  Install : Add CLI
  Configure : Read settings
  Run : Start services

journey
  title Synthetic journey
  section Example
    Read config: 3: Developer
    Start services: 4: Developer

xychart-beta
  title "Synthetic counts"
  x-axis [A, B]
  y-axis "Count" 0 --> 3
  bar [1, 2]

architecture-beta
  group host[Host]
  service cli[CLI] in host
  service engine[Engine] in host
  cli:B --> T:engine
  align column cli engine

cynefin-beta
  clear
    "Read instructions"
  complicated
    "Inspect implementation"
  complex
    "Try experiment"
  chaotic
    "Contain failure"
  confusion
    "Ask owner"

ishikawa-beta
  Route fails
  DNS
    Wrong address
  Proxy
    Missing route

radar-beta
  axis a["A"], b["B"], c["C"]
  curve example["Synthetic"]{1, 2, 3}
  max 3
  min 0

railroad-ebnf-beta
  command = "hack" "logs" [ service ] ;

swimlane-beta TB
  subgraph CLI
    Read[Read config]
  end
  subgraph Engine
    Start[Start services]
  end
  Read --> Start

treeView-beta
  .hack/
    hack.config.json
    docker-compose.yml

treemap-beta
  "Synthetic group"
    "A": 2
    "B": 1

usecase-beta
  direction LR
  actor dev("Developer")
  systemBoundary "CLI"
    Start("Start services")
  end
  dev --> Start

venn-beta
  set Config
  set Runtime
  union Config,Runtime["Project"]

wardley-beta
  anchor User [0.9, 0.4]
  component CLI [0.6, 0.5]
  component Engine [0.2, 0.8]
  User -> CLI
  CLI -> Engine
